extraction.agency_name: Department of Public Safety and Correctional Services
extraction.parent_department: Department of Public Safety and Correctional Services

findings.title: Cash Receipts Were Not Adequately Controlled
findings.description: The Region lacked adequate controls over cash receipts. Specifically, while collections were recorded on pre-numbered cash receipt forms, the Region did not periodically account for these forms as to issued, voided, and on hand.

dollar_amounts.context: Region’s cash receipts totaled approximately $2.2 million during fiscal year 2007

findings.recommendation: We recommend that the Region periodically account for all pre-numbered cash receipts forms as to issued, voided, and on-hand.

findings.title: The Region Lacked Sufficient Controls Over Materials and Supplies
findings.description: Controls over the Region’s materials and supplies were inadequate. Copies of completed requisition forms were not provided to employees who received inmate and officer clothing items, and the Region had not compared copies of completed requisition forms used to post perpetual inventory records with those retained by employees since September 2007.

dollar_amounts.context: Region’s expenditures for materials and supplies totaled approximately $3.8 million
including $400,000 for inmate and officer clothing

findings.recommendation: We recommend that the Region comply with the applicable requirements of the Department of General Services’ Inventory Control Manual.

findings.title: Vendor Invoices Were Not Properly Reviewed Prior to Payment
findings.description: The Region did not adequately control disbursements made via the State’s Financial Management Information System (FMIS). The employee who approved vendor invoices and released related disbursement transactions did not ensure that any of the related goods or services were received by reviewing supporting documentation.

dollar_amounts.context: Region used FMIS to process disbursements totaling approximately $7.5 million

findings.recommendation: We recommend that the disbursement approval process include a review of supporting documentation, at least on a test basis.

findings.title: The Region Lacked Adequate Procedures for the Issuance of Corporate Purchasing Cards
findings.description: The Region lacked adequate procedures for the issuance of its corporate purchasing cards. The employee who requested purchasing cards from the Department also received the cards and distributed them to applicable employees.

dollar_amounts.context: made related purchases totaling approximately $1 million

findings.recommendation: We recommend that the Region employee who requests purchasing cards from the Department not also receive and distribute the cards. We advised the Region on accomplishing the necessary separation of duties using existing personnel.

extraction.agency_response_summary: The Department of Public Safety and Correctional Services’ response to this audit, on behalf of the Region, is included as an appendix to this report.
extraction.extraction_notes: No findings marked with asterisk or noted as repeat. No criminal referrals stated. Agency agreement/disagreement details not provided in text (only reference to appendix).
